title: Facet joint forces
summary: Apply each pure moment, eccentric or combined load and report the facet contact force, or the share of axial load carried by the facets.
simulate: Build the specimen named in the task (FSU or multi-level lumbar spine); keep facet capsules unless stated.
Fix the caudal end; apply the pure moment, axial load or imposed rotation of the task.
Facet force = compressive contact force (N, positive) on the facet named in the task: right, loaded or mean of both.
Loaded facet: the compressed one (ipsilateral in lateral bending, contralateral in axial rotation, both in extension).
Facet share = total facet force normal to the disc plane / applied axial force x 100.

notes: Force is per facet and compressive (positive). Zhu 2008 film and gauge values are the same specimens (listed as two studies, shared); Zhu flexion gauge value is excluded because it sums tensile and compressive readings.

Excluded: Wilson 2006 (facets measured after nucleotomy, capsule and ligament sectioning: an injured specimen built for sensor calibration); Ianuzzi 2004 (capsule strain, not force); Ivicsics force vectors and capsule-free shares.

Secondary values (review, n not given) enter only where the primary is not in bench/tests; review copies of Sawa, Schendel, Zhu, Ivicsics, Wilson and Popovich are left out. Farooq flexion row is printed identical to compression in the review and is left out.
Schendel peaks are the largest single values printed in the abstract, not means.
agent_prompt: Use your finite element lumbar spine model. For each task build the specimen in its inputs, fix the caudal end and apply the load: pure moment, axial or follower compression, eccentric compression, or an imposed rotation. Report the facet contact force in newtons, compressive positive, for the facet named in "facet" (right, mean of both, or the loaded one: ipsilateral in lateral bending, contralateral in axial rotation). For "facet_share" report total facet force as % of the applied axial force; for "facet_slope" report the slope of facet force versus applied moment (N/Nm). Return JSON with one entry per task id, as in answer_format.
